hypotheses.title: Orthogonal Multi-Domain Premia: Options Variance, Revision Acceleration and Asset Backing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: By systematically tapping independent data sources—options volatility surfaces, proprietary revision acceleration derivatives, and balance sheet tangible asset fair values—we harvest decorrelated risk premia that share near-zero co-movement with income-statement earnings yields. High options variance risk premium reflects excessive downside hedging demand; high revision acceleration reflects pre-announcement institutional momentum; and high asset fair value relative to market price in large caps reflects tangible equity floor backing. Each candidate employs subindustry neutralization and short-term price reversal or long-horizon lookbacks to achieve Sharpe >= 1.50 and self-correlation < 0.35 against submitted Alpha 10.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if options implied volatility accurately prices future realized variance or if revision acceleration reverses before quarterly earnings releases.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1: Options Variance Risk Premium (VRP) 1-year trajectory with 15% 3-day reversal stabilizer in TOP1000
Candidate 2: Analyst Revision Acceleration 120-day derivative rank with 15% 3-day reversal stabilizer in TOP1000
Candidate 3: Large-cap Asset Fair Value Backing with 170-day lookback in TOPSP500 and Market neutralization (Alpha 8 Crown Jewel Architecture)
